verdict.rationale: Groq's evidence covers only inference primitives (chat completions, tool use, MCP tool integration, batch processing, structured outputs) — none of which describe a scheduling/trigger system for autonomous background automations; batch jobs are asynchronous request batches, not persistent background agents. Missing for 10: any documented scheduler, cron/trigger mechanism, persistent background agent runtime, or workflow orchestration feature that lets a user 'set up' an automation to run unattended.
